meta.parties: Silva Et Al. v. Banda Et Al

rules.statement: The lessee is entitled to compensation for improvements made, even if the buildings were not of a permanent nature as defined by the covenant.
rules.supporting_quote: "What happened was that fourteen tenements were built in place of the fourteen tenements Which had been condemned by the Municipal Council and which were demolished; the appellants contend, that these are not buildings of the nature referred to in the covenant. The learned Judge, however, accepted the fact that the trustee must have seen the operations, but rejects his account of the facts."
